name: @builderforce/kimi-oauth
description: The Kimi Code OAuth protocol, in one place: the public client id, the auth host and its env overrides, the request shapes for the device-authorization / device-code / refresh grants, and the parser that turns a raw response into a decided outcome. Shared by the API Worker (web 'connect your subscription' device flow) and the VS Code extension (refresh against the user's local Kimi Code install), so a client-id or endpoint rotation is one edit rather than two. Dependency-free and I/O-free by contract: it builds requests and reads responses, it never performs one.
